Which countries can you ship to?
Most countries can be reached with the right routing. Tell us the destination and we will set out the options, transit time and any restrictions.
Do you ship to sanctioned countries?

We only move cargo that is permitted. Every shipment to a sensitive destination is screened against applicable sanctions and export-control rules before booking, and we decline anything that is not allowed.
We ship to the best gateway port and arrange the inland leg by truck, rail or air. For some Central African destinations our air–sea bridge is faster than an all-sea route and cheaper than all-air.
Is insurance available for these routes?
Usually, yes, though some routes need war and strikes cover or carry higher premiums. We arrange cargo insurance with licensed insurers.
Why do transit times vary so much?
Fewer direct sailings, transhipment, border procedures and seasonal conditions all play a part. We give realistic ranges and keep you updated on the way.
